_about: Assumed inputs, arm specifications and preregistered parameters for 4.9 more radar. Built 2026-11-05 by the build agent. Change freely. Path specs resolve through expkit: {key, rel}, {exp, rel}, {area, rel}. Every arm number is an assumption (VERIFY) until a catalogue check or a delivered product replaces it.

prereg.delta_gain_note: prior gate value. User decision 1 in framework section 6. Source of the margin is the burden tradeoff, never fold spread

power.g_for_power_note: null means delta_gain + 0.01 (framework S1 rule). With success defined as lower bound above delta, power at delta + 0.01 stays under about 0.5 unless the half-width is under 0.01, so the rule makes almost every stratum ineligible. Lead to decide (see decisions_4_9.md)

prereg.lidar_weak_quantile_note: 2026-11-06 (4.9-01). Kept for the share of targets in lidar_weak. The stratum is no longer chosen on the baseline score. See lidar_weak

lidar_weak.note: 2026-11-06 (4.9-01). External lidar-weakness covariate, a rows column both arms see equally (for example base:control:cover with weak_side high). Never the baseline score. null means lidar_weak is not formed and is reported as undefined. User decision (decisions_4_9.md)

prereg.primary_stratum_note: 2026-11-06 (4.9-01). The framework names lidar_weak as primary, but defines it on the baseline score, which manufactures gain. Primary is all until the user fixes the lidar_weak covariate. lidar_weak is secondary
prereg.max_undefined_share_note: SH-01. Share of undefined bootstrap draws tolerated before the interval is undefined (inconclusive). 0 follows expkit

pit.contrast_note: assumed backscatter contrast of a pit against surrounding forest (VERIFY from A1 pilot)

baseline_rows_9t.note: Per-row out-of-fold rich lidar baseline score on the de-duplicated 9t rows. Not saved by _nisar_feat_dedupe_9t.py (it keeps only the summary). Build with _sar_new_features_9t.py --rows-only, then score with _sar_new_score_9t.py --baseline-only

baseline_rows_613590.note: held. Columns row, y, block, and one score column per feature set

nisar_samples.note: rows come from _nisar_feat_common.load_samples(target, suffix) with NISAR_STACK=slc. Pads use LOCAL_M=1500

catalogue.note: Vendor and agency catalogue rows. A hit is not a product. Overrides n_acq per arm when present

scatterers.note: Permanent point scatterers. ref_x, ref_y from a survey or orthophoto, not from the lidar-based check used before

stack.note: Geocoded, terrain-flattened linear power, one band per date, EPSG:6346. Optional coherence stack sar_{arm}_coh_stack_9t.tif. Optional T3 sar_{arm}_t3_9t.tif with bands T11 T22 T33 T12re T12im T13re T13im T23re T23im
